name: BCC Email Per Product
author: DreamCode Infotech

sections.description:
Enhance your WooCommerce store’s email capabilities with product-specific BCC email notifications. This plugin allows store administrators to assign unique BCC (Blind Carbon Copy) email addresses to individual products. When an order is placed, notifications are automatically sent to the designated recipients for each product, keeping team members informed in real time.

Features

  • Product-Specific BCC Email Configuration

    • Add custom BCC email addresses for each product
    • Support for multiple BCC recipients per product
    • Easy-to-use interface in the product editor

  • WooCommerce Integration

    • Seamless integration with WooCommerce order system
    • Compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)
    • Works with all WooCommerce email templates

  • Technical Specifications

    • Requires WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
    • Compatible with WordPress 5.8+
    • PHP 7.4 or higher required
    • Tested with WordPress 7.0
    • Tested with WooCommerce 9.5
    • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatible
    • Supports WooCommerce Blocks

Privacy Policy

This plugin does not collect any personal data. All email addresses added through this plugin are stored in your WordPress database and are only used for sending order notifications.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/bcc-email-per-product directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. For each product, you can now set specific BCC email addresses in the product editor under the “BCC Email” tab.
  4. Configure which email notifications (New Order, Processing, Completed, Cancelled) should be sent to the BCC email address.
sections.faq:
How do I add BCC emails to a product?

Go to the product editor in WooCommerce, and you’ll find a new tab called “BCC Email” where you can add an email address and select which notification types to send.

Can I add multiple BCC emails for a single product?

Currently, you can add one BCC email address per product. If you need to notify multiple people, consider using a distribution list or group email address.

Will the BCC emails receive the full order details?

Yes, the BCC recipients will receive a complete email including product details, customer information, and order totals. However, they will only see the products they are configured to receive notifications for, not the entire order.

Is this plugin compatible with the latest WooCommerce version?

Yes, the plugin is tested and compatible with WooCommerce up to version 9.5, WordPress 6.7, and supports HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) and WooCommerce Blocks.

What happens if an order contains multiple products with different BCC emails?

Each BCC email recipient will receive a separate email containing only the products they are configured to receive notifications for, along with the order and customer details.

Can I choose which order statuses trigger the BCC emails?

Yes! You can select from New Order, Processing Order, Completed Order, and Cancelled Order notifications for each product.

Does this work with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce HPOS and has been tested with this feature enabled.

Will this slow down my checkout process?

No, the emails are sent asynchronously and will not affect your checkout performance.
